name: Bidkar
title: Jehu's adjutant
summary: Bidkar was an officer and adjutant (or captain) who served under King Jehu of Israel. He accompanied Jehu when Joram, son of Ahab, was killed, and was ordered to throw Joram's body onto Naboth's vineyard in accordance with the Lord's judgment against Ahab's house.

keyEvents.title: Servant under Jehu
keyEvents.description: Bidkar served as an adjutant (shalish) under Jehu, a trusted military position in the Israelite army.

keyEvents.title: The Killing of King Joram
keyEvents.description: When Jehu shot Joram with an arrow, he ordered Bidkar to throw his body away. Bidkar obeyed the command immediately.

keyEvents.title: Joram's Body Thrown onto Naboth's Vineyard
keyEvents.description: Bidkar took up Joram's body and threw it into the field that had belonged to Naboth of Jezreel, fulfilling the Lord's judgment against Ahab's house.

keyEvents.title: Remembering the Lord's prophecy against Ahab
keyEvents.description: Jehu reminded Bidkar how they had both ridden together behind Ahab when the Lord pronounced judgment on him for murdering Naboth and his sons.

keyEvents.title: The fulfillment of Elijah's prophecy
keyEvents.description: Bidkar's act of throwing Joram's body onto Naboth's land was a direct fulfillment of the prophet Elijah's words that Ahab's blood would be avenged on that same piece of ground.
